data.define: Slang for something excellent or stylish.

misuse.text: Don't yell 'fire' in a crowded room.

data.l1_hook: मेरे नए स्नीकर्स देखो! ये "fire" है।

native.tip: “fire” = बहुत शानदार. उदाहरण: “Those sneakers are fire!”
